basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old vape enthusiast living in Columbus, Ohio. After quitting smoking, I got into vaping and have been exploring different mods and juices ever since. I work as a mechanical technician, which gives me a knack for understanding the technical aspects of vaping gear. In my free time, I enjoy working on my Acura and following the latest political memes. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after work, around 6-10 PM EST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid understanding of mechanical systems due to my job as a mechanical technician. This has translated well into my hobby of vaping, where I enjoy tinkering with different mods. I am mostly self-taught, picking up tips from online forums and YouTube tutorials.
